verses.text: Hollow and deceptive philosophy . . . depends on human tradition and the elemental spiritual forces of this world rather than on Christ.
verses.title: Not Ritual but Christ

verses.text: Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that their deeds will be exposed. But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what they have done has been done in the sight of God.
A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
